description: 水利署河川主題網站 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集主要係彙整水利署以及所屬機關河川主題之網站進行列表，並轉化成開放資料服務，期能提供使用者方辦查詢到河川相關網站並提供多元化資料開放格式給公眾加值應用，藉以提升水利資源資料運用效率及施政透明度，落實資源資訊共用共享理念。 已將各主題網、台灣河川復育網、永續公共工程專屬網、水利電子報主題網、水資料應用平臺……等河川相關網站加以整理，並... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
